## Design Token Canonical Values

One source of truth. All repos mirror these manually. No shared npm package.

```css
--ia-black:        #030303;   /* impactors-academy canonical — ia-pro was #0a0a0a (DRIFT) */
--ia-obsidian:     #161616;
--ia-white:        #fafafa;
--ia-cream:        #F2EDE4;
--ia-acid:         #C8F135;
--ia-terra:        #C87B3F;
--ia-terra-light:  #E8A87A;
--ia-terra-dark:   #8B4E22;
--ia-amber:        #D4A84B;
--ia-gray-200:     #e5e5e5;
--ia-gray-400:     #a3a3a3;
--ia-gray-600:     #525252;
--ia-gray-900:     #171717;
```

Motion, spacing, and radius tokens are identical across both repos — no drift.
Font bodies differ intentionally: IA uses General Sans, IA Pro uses Source Serif 4.

## Standing Rules (org-wide)

- No new external SaaS dependency without flagging it — self-hosted by default
- Every push goes to the project's own GitHub remote, not the workspace remote
- Secrets go in Vaultwarden, not in chat, not in git
- No shared npm package for tokens — canonical values documented here, mirrored manually
- AGENTS.md must exist in every repo alongside CLAUDE.md — OpenClaw + other agents read it
- LOC never implements an in-house checkout/payment — always link out to provider's system
- GrindBuddy backend work is paused — do not action until explicitly un-paused
- VPS capacity check required before Phase 1 begins (`/senior-devops`)
